parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First UTC day of the range, `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. Omitted = 29 days before `to` (a 30-day range).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last UTC day of the range, `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. Omitted = today. At most 366 days from `from`; `from` after `to` is `invalid-report-range`.
